name: 🎨 Theme System
description: Migrazione completa a `heca-theme`: crate standalone, temi bundled (`grid_tron`, `mocha`, `latte`), migrazione di `heca-config`, `heca-grid-ui` e app principale, rimozione dei colori hardcoded e migrazione del chrome hand-drawn verso widget grid-ui. Completata.

acceptedDecisions.title: Theme authoring reference: how a theme is found, written and overridden
acceptedDecisions.decision:
Source: the old theming documentation file (a planning file, now a historical archive; sections 1-11). Condensed; the exact values of the bundled themes (grid_tron, mocha, latte) are NOT copied here because they live in heca-theme/src/themes/*.toml.

RESOLUTION ORDER. A theme loaded by name resolves: (1) ~/.config/heca/themes/{name}.toml, (2) bundled heca-theme/src/themes/{name}.toml, (3) fallback to bundled grid_tron.toml. Loading never fails to give a valid theme. Selection: [settings] theme = "grid_tron" (not under [appearance]). Bundled names: grid_tron, mocha, latte.

FONTS ARE NOT PART OF A THEME. Fonts are system-local, not portable; a theme that shipped a font family would break on a machine without it. Fonts live in the [font] block of config.toml (heca-config/src/font.rs): [font.family.ui] and [font.family.terminal] with normal, bold, italic, bold_italic (all optional; unset falls back to normal, then to the embedded font: Geist Mono for UI, Maple Mono Normal NF for terminal; italic falls back to a synthesized oblique), and [font.size] ui = 15.0, terminal = 14.0. Reload with prefix+Shift+r.

CREATING A THEME. Put a TOML file in ~/.config/heca/themes/my_theme.toml (user) or heca-theme/src/themes/my_theme.toml (bundled; then also add it to bundled_themes() and available_themes() in heca-theme/src/loader.rs). Steps: copy an existing theme, change name, adjust the palette, set sidebar/bar tokens if you want exact control; omitted optional tokens derive or fall back.

FORMAT. A theme is a TOML file read into heca_theme::Theme. Fields: name; palette background, surface, foreground, muted, border, accent, glow, danger, success, warning; geometry border_radius, border_width, pane_padding; chrome backgrounds left_sidebar_background, right_sidebar_background, top_bottom_pane_background; effects glow_size (none|thin|medium|large), intensity (off|low|medium|heavy), show_focus_border, icon_secondary_alpha, active_wash_alpha (default 0.11, accent wash over the active workspace), card_background_alpha (default 0.02), shadow = { color, alpha, blur }; floating float_background, float_accent, float_focus; drag and drop drag_ghost_bg, drag_ghost_fg, drag_source_bg, drag_source_border, drop_target_bg, drop_target_border, drop_insertion; sidebar_label_font_size (14.0), sidebar_button_font_size (11.0); terminal terminal_foreground, terminal_background, terminal_cursor_foreground, terminal_cursor_background, terminal_cursor_border, terminal_selection_foreground, terminal_selection_background, terminal_ansi (8 colors), terminal_brights (8 colors).

REQUIRED vs OPTIONAL. In practice set: name, background, foreground, border, accent, border_radius, border_width. Everything else is optional with a default or derivation. If the three chrome backgrounds are omitted they derive from background: sidebars = background darkened slightly, top/bottom pane bars = darkened a bit more (Theme::effective_left_sidebar_background, effective_right_sidebar_background, effective_top_bottom_pane_background).

TOKEN MEANINGS. background = app canvas; surface = elevated cards/pills; foreground = primary text/icon; muted = secondary text/icon; border = default border; accent = active/highlight; glow = glow color; danger/success/warning = destructive-error / positive / attention. top_bottom_pane_background = top bar, bottom bar and pane title band. glow_size owns glow (presence, radius, strength) and is the sole owner of glow. intensity owns ONLY the scanline/CRT overlay opacity (Off = none, Heavy = strongest); it does not affect glow (older docs that said otherwise were wrong). Both are overridable at runtime in [appearance].

TERMINAL THEMING. Theme terminal_* fields reach the terminal backend through heca/src/app/backend_factory.rs and heca_core::backend::TerminalPaletteDefaults. The renderer uses TerminalSnapshot.default_fg, default_bg and cursor_color (the cursor follows the backend palette). Not fully tokenized then: some host-drawn overlays use policy logic, selection/caret overlays derive from the app accent in some paths.

APPEARANCE vs THEME. Theme = base palette and tokens. [appearance] = local overrides that win where implemented: pane_border_color, pane_active_border_color, pane_floating_border_color, pane_border_width, pane_border_radius, pane_padding, glow_size, intensity (unset inherits the theme), and transparency/blur controls (transparency, blur, terminal_transparency, terminal_floating_transparency, terminal_floating_blur, background_blur, background_transparency, background_gradient_top, background_gradient_bottom, vibrancy). Removed and must not be re-added under [appearance]: pane_title_color, pane_title_background; express pane title color with theme tokens.

EXAMPLE. A user theme "My Dark Blue" saved as ~/.config/heca/themes/my_dark_blue.toml (background #111827, surface #1f2937, foreground #e5e7eb, accent #38bdf8, glow_size thin, intensity low, terminal_* set) and selected with [settings] theme = "my_dark_blue".

SOURCE OF TRUTH if the doc and the code disagree: heca-theme theme code (the file named theme.rs in the doc is now heca-theme/src/theme/mod.rs), heca-theme/src/loader.rs, heca-theme/src/themes/*.toml, heca-config/src/appearance.rs, heca-config/src/font.rs.
acceptedDecisions.rationale: The only full field reference for themes exists in a file that is now a historical archive, not maintained (T561). README.md:982 has only a 3-line blurb. Without this, a person writing a theme has to read Rust code.
acceptedDecisions.implementationNotes: Needs a new user-facing docs/theming.md reconciled to the current heca-theme code (the file the old doc names, heca-theme/src/theme.rs, is now theme/mod.rs). Bundled values stay in heca-theme/src/themes/*.toml. The doc's note about heca-grid-ui not yet being migrated (theming-03) is out of date: P003(F001) is done. Also fix compositor-blur-refactor-plan.md:498, which asks to remove terminal_frost_color from this doc.
